# User arbitrations of the blocking report (verbatim, French)

Arbitrages (rapport bloquant, section 7) :

Q1 : (b). Ajouter à §63 « la destination est utilisable dans l'état d'arrivée ».
Q2 : lecture mixte sur l'état d'arrivée : invariants du noyau sur l'état entier, plus ArenaInv de la nouvelle entrée ; NewArenaBase porte cette lecture.
Q3 : réalisation par des pas du noyau. freeSlot (contrat HandlePool v0.5) marque l'entrée libre et incrémente la génération ; préconditions : droit d'administration, pool vivant, handle valide, aucune feuille de l'entrée à Init (Uninit ou Moved), aucune autorité active dérivée d'une compagne de ce pool sur l'entrée ; aucun effet d'endUse. Deux preuves obligatoires :
  (1) témoin complet depuis l'état initial par des pas autorisés : newPool, allocSlot, resolve Modify, écriture, transfer de la valeur vers un local de même forme, unresolve, freeSlot accepté ;
  (2) la mise à jour des métadonnées (état libre, génération) est réalisable par une écriture autorisée sous le droit d'administration.
Q4 : garantie par pool : réécrire D.2, D.3 et D.4(3) sur les compagnes du pool du slot ; les pools imbriqués restent permis ; I1 et les garanties du noyau restent prouvées sur l'état entier.
Q5 : la validation du handle précède le contrôle du droit : fail dans les deux cas.
Q6 : réécrire §86 s4 : « La réémission ne modifie ni les octets ni l'état d'initialisation. Une lecture reste soumise aux conditions ordinaires du modèle mémoire, notamment Init, aux droits d'accès et à la validité de représentation pour le type demandé. La Spec 4 déterminera les obligations de construction et de typage des valeurs réémises. »
Q7 : restreindre §78.3 aux ancres du sous-arbre strict de internal qui couvrent une feuille du stockage administré ; prouver que la clause découle de §78.2 et de I3 (lecture Q9), et l'équivalence de reset avec sa séquence du noyau dans les deux sens.
Q8 : ajouter à §47 : le graphe de possession des statiques est acyclique.
Q9 et Q26 : « valide » = active. §69.2 : endUse est rejeté si une autorité détenue par place a un descendant actif détenu ailleurs.
Q10 : (a).
Q11 : (a) fail ; (b) reject ; (c) reject ; (d) mark exige AdminRight ; (e) grow suit le détenteur actuel du bloc ; (f) fail avant le contrôle du droit (contrat DS-v2).
Q12 : avec le nouveau freeSlot, un handle d'entrée libre est périmé : fail.
Q13 : §71.2 inchangé ; préciser au §36 que MetaRight vise la création ou le recyclage d'autorités sur un stockage existant, pas la création d'une allocation fraîche par alloc ; la concurrence entre appels relève de la spec 2.
Q14 : « opérations d'accès » = O9–O11 ; le préciser au §59.
Q15 : restreindre §40 aux emplacements racines utilisables, comme §49.7.
Q16 : définir I5 : toute feuille épinglée appartient à un emplacement utilisable.
Q17 : lecture actuelle.
Q18 : région dont toutes les feuilles sont de taille nulle : base et provenance de l'allocation de l'ancre effective, comme la région vide.
Q19 : H31a : le jumeau à plusieurs pas (conjonct 5) est accepté.
Q20 : non bloquants (classés).
Q21 : pour chaque cas dont le verdict attendu change, conserver le verdict historique, sa justification et le nouveau verdict fondé sur la v0.1 (tableau dans la description de PR) :
  - H21, H50, H51 : nouveau verdict = verdict obtenu ;
  - H49 : conservé comme test de régression, verdict = verdict obtenu, blocage résiduel documenté (décision NoLock) ; exception explicite : le reset rejeté de H49 est dispensé de jumeau positif ;
  - H16 classé spec 3 ; W2 et W3 : les variantes deviennent les cas ; MM2-H H01 : la variante devient le jumeau ; H10 : l'accès sort de l'allocation ; W1 : la valeur est retirée avant freeSlot.
Q22 : non bloquants (frontières ouvertes de la spec) ; exitRoots retenu comme réalisation de référence.
Q23 : lectures dont un témoin du rapport change un verdict :
  - B#1, B#15, B#33, SP-A4, machine S1 et S2 : lectures actuelles conservées (B#15 imposée par Q9) ;
  - B#28 : remplacée par Q9 ;
  - B#45 : remplacée : chaque pin crée une obligation d'épinglage d'identité fraîche ; une feuille est épinglée tant qu'une obligation active la couvre ; unpin désigne une obligation et ne lève qu'elle ; K.ExternalDone porte sur cette obligation ;
  - H-R5 : sans objet ; DS-R1 à DS-R13 : tranchées par Q11, Q27 et Q28.
  Les lectures sans témoin de différence sont conservées.
Q24 : le fournisseur doit être un emplacement utilisable (§71.2).
Q25 : (b).
Q27 : (a).

195	of `allocSlot` is a kernel `write` by some authority. -/
196	def COp.kok (C : CState) : COp → Bool
197	  | .allocSlot _ dst => (writer C.kern dst).isSome

205	/-- Computed outcome of `allocSlot(pool j, dst)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §58). -/
206	def allocSlotOut (P : HandlePool.PState) (j dst : Nat) : Outcome3 HandlePool.PState :=
207	  match P.pools[j]? with
208	  | none => .reject
209	  | some pl =>
210	    if HandlePool.AllocSlotStatic P.kern pl dst then
211	      match firstFree pl.slots with
212	      | some (i, sl) => .ok (HandlePool.allocSlotEff P j pl i sl dst)
213	      | none => .fail
214	    else .reject

216	/-- Computed outcome of `resolve(h, m)` on pool `j` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58). -/
217	def resolveOut (P : HandlePool.PState) (j : Nat) (h : HandlePool.Handle) (m : Mode) :
218	    Outcome3 HandlePool.PState :=
219	  match P.pools[j]? with
220	  | none => .reject
221	  | some pl =>
222	    if HandlePool.ResolveRight P.kern pl m then
223	      if HandlePool.HandleOK pl h then
224	        match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
225	        | some sl =>
226	          if DerivePre (HandlePool.compS P.kern pl m) P.kern.A.length
227	              (footprint P.kern.P sl.place) m then
228	            .ok { P with
229	              kern := deriveEff (HandlePool.compS P.kern pl m) P.kern.A.length
230	                (footprint P.kern.P sl.place) m
231	              res := P.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, P.kern.A.length, m,
232	                [(P.kern.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] }
233	          else .reject
234	        | none => .reject
235	      else .fail
236	    else .reject

238	/-- Computed outcome of `resolveMany(hs, m)` on pool `j` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58). -/
239	def resolveManyOut (P : HandlePool.PState) (j : Nat) (hs : List HandlePool.Handle) (m : Mode) :
240	    Outcome3 HandlePool.PState :=
241	  match P.pools[j]? with
242	  | none => .reject
243	  | some pl =>
244	    if HandlePool.ResolveRight P.kern pl m then
245	      if HandlePool.BatchOK pl hs m then
246	        if HandlePool.EntriesPre k m (HandlePool.compS P.kern pl m) P.kern.A.length
247	            (HandlePool.entryRegions P.kern pl hs) then
248	          .ok { P with
249	            kern := HandlePool.entriesEff m (HandlePool.compS P.kern pl m) P.kern.A.length
250	              (HandlePool.entryRegions P.kern pl hs)
251	            res := P.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, P.kern.A.length, m,
252	              HandlePool.batchEntries P.kern.A.length hs⟩] }
253	        else .reject
254	      else .fail
255	    else .reject

257	/-- Computed outcome of `unresolve(c)` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.2; §58). -/
258	def unresolveOut (P : HandlePool.PState) (c : Nat) : Outcome3 HandlePool.PState :=
259	  match HandlePool.findRes P c with
260	  | none => .reject
261	  | some r =>
262	    match HandlePool.releaseAll P.kern (HandlePool.unresolveList P.kern r) with
263	    | none => .reject
264	    | some s' => .ok { P with kern := s' }

266	/-- Computed outcome of `freeSlot(h)` on pool `j` (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3; §58). -/
267	def freeSlotOut (P : HandlePool.PState) (j : Nat) (h : HandlePool.Handle) :
268	    Outcome3 HandlePool.PState :=
269	  match P.pools[j]? with
270	  | none => .reject
271	  | some pl =>
272	    if HandlePool.AdminRight P.kern pl then
273	      if HandlePool.HandleOK pl h then
274	        match pl.slots[h.slot]? with
275	        | some sl =>
276	          if HandlePool.ContentEndPre k P.kern sl.place pl.internal then
277	            .ok (HandlePool.freeSlotEff P j pl h.slot sl)
278	          else .reject
279	        | none => .reject
280	      else .fail
281	    else .reject

283	/-- Computed outcome of `push(j, size, dst)` (DS-v1; Part XIV, §77; §58). -/
284	def pushOut (D : DataStack.DState) (j size dst : Nat) : Outcome3 DataStack.DState :=
285	  match D.stacks[j]? with
286	  | none => .reject
287	  | some st =>
288	    if IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (DataStack.cellsOf st st.top size) dst then
289	      if st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length then
290	        if SplitPre k D.kern st.internal [DataStack.cellsOf st st.top size] then
291	          if StorePre (splitEff D.kern st.internal [DataStack.cellsOf st st.top size])
292	              D.kern.A.length dst then
293	            .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff D.kern st.internal [DataStack.cellsOf st st.top size])
294	              D.kern.A.length dst,
295	              D.stacks.set j (DataStack.pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩
296	          else .reject
297	        else .reject
298	      else .fail
299	    else .reject

301	/-- Computed outcome of `mark(j)` (DS-v1; §58). -/
302	def markOut (D : DataStack.DState) (j : Nat) : Outcome3 DataStack.DState :=
303	  match D.stacks[j]? with
304	  | none => .reject
305	  | some st => .ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (DataStack.markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩
306	
307	/-- Computed outcome of `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v1; Part XIV, §78; §58). -/
308	def rewindOut (D : DataStack.DState) (j : Nat) (m : DataStack.Mark) :
309	    Outcome3 DataStack.DState :=
310	  match D.stacks[j]? with
311	  | none => .reject
312	  | some st =>
313	    if DataStack.LiveMark j st m then
314	      if DataStack.AdminRight D.kern st then
315	        if SplitPre k D.kern st.internal [DataStack.above st m] then
316	          if ReleasePre (splitEff D.kern st.internal [DataStack.above st m])
317	              D.kern.A.length then
318	            .ok ⟨releaseEff (splitEff D.kern st.internal [DataStack.above st m])
319	              D.kern.A.length, D.stacks.set j (DataStack.rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩
320	          else .reject
321	        else .reject
322	      else .reject
323	    else .fail

325	/-- Computed outcome of `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v1; Part XIV, §77; §58). -/
326	def growOut (D : DataStack.DState) (j b extra : Nat) : Outcome3 DataStack.DState :=
327	  match D.stacks[j]? with
328	  | none => .reject
329	  | some st =>
330	    match st.block b with
331	    | none => .reject
332	    | some x =>
333	      if extra = 0 then .reject else
334	      if ReleasePre D.kern b then
335	        if IssueStatic (releaseEff D.kern b) st.entry
336	            (DataStack.cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst then
337	          if DataStack.InPlace st x extra then
338	            if SplitPre k (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
339	                [DataStack.cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] then
340	              if StorePre (splitEff (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
341	                  [DataStack.cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)])
342	                  (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length x.dst then
343	                .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff (releaseEff D.kern b) st.internal
344	                    [DataStack.cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)])
345	                    (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length x.dst,
346	                  D.stacks.set j (DataStack.growMeta st x extra (releaseEff D.kern b).A.length),
347	                  D.fresh⟩
348	              else .reject
349	            else .reject
350	          else .fail
351	        else .reject
352	      else .reject

354	/-- The computed outcome of `o` from `C` (§58, §60–§78; HandlePool v0.4 annex; DS-v1): the
355	executor of `Ern.Corpus` on the arena projection for O1–O16, `issue` and `reset`; the guard of §56
356	over all registries for the creation operations; the pool and stack executors above. -/
357	def cstep (C : CState) : COp → Outcome3 CState
358	  | .derive a r m => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.derive a r m))
359	  | .split a rs => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.split a rs))
360	  | .release a => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.release a))
361	  | .transfer a b => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.transfer a b))
362	  | .depend q x => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.depend q x))
363	  | .enter ps ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.enter ps ls))
364	  | .exit => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL .exit)
365	  | .read a ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.read a ls))
366	  | .write a ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.write a ls))
367	  | .writeShared a ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.writeShared a ls))
368	  | .pin p => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.pin p))
369	  | .unpin p => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.unpin p))
370	  | .endUse p => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.endUse p))
371	  | .free p a => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.free p a))
372	  | .alloc pr ow ls => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.alloc pr ow ls))
373	  | .store a p => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.store a p))
374	  | .newArena st i =>
375	    if NewArenaPre C.kern C.arenas C.othersA st i then .ok (C.setL (newArenaEff C.toL st i))
376	    else .reject
377	  | .issue i r d => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.issue i r d))
378	  | .reset i => liftO C.setL (lstep k C.toL (.reset i))
379	  | .newPool st i =>
380	    if HandlePool.NewPoolPre C.kern C.pools C.othersP st i then
381	      .ok (C.setP (HandlePool.newPoolEff C.toP st i))
382	    else .reject
383	  | .allocSlot j d => liftO C.setP (allocSlotOut C.toP j d)
384	  | .resolve j h m => liftO C.setP (resolveOut C.toP j h m)
385	  | .resolveMany j hs m => liftO C.setP (resolveManyOut k C.toP j hs m)
386	  | .unresolve c => liftO C.setP (unresolveOut C.toP c)
387	  | .freeSlot j h => liftO C.setP (freeSlotOut k C.toP j h)
388	  | .newStack st i =>
389	    if DataStack.NewStackPre C.kern C.stacks C.othersD st i then
390	      .ok (C.setD (DataStack.newStackEff C.toD st i))
391	    else .reject
392	  | .push j n d => liftO C.setD (pushOut k C.toD j n d)
393	  | .mark j => liftO C.setD (markOut C.toD j)
394	  | .rewind j m => liftO C.setD (rewindOut k C.toD j m)
395	  | .grow j b e => liftO C.setD (growOut k C.toD j b e)

397	/-- The state after `o` from `C` when it is `ok`; `C` otherwise (§58). -/
398	def cnext (C : CState) (o : COp) : CState :=
399	  match cstep k C o with
400	  | .ok C' => C'
401	  | _ => C
402	
403	/-- The state reached by `os` from `C` when every step is `ok` and every `allocSlot` handle write
404	is a kernel write (§58, §67); `none` otherwise. -/
405	def crun (C : CState) : List COp → Option CState
406	  | [] => some C
407	  | o :: os =>
408	    match cstep k C o with
409	    | .ok C' => if o.kok C then crun C' os else none
410	    | _ => none
411	
412	/-- The state reached by `os` from `CState.init statics` (§47); `CState.init statics` when the run
413	does not complete (used only under `(crun …).isSome = true`, see `crunsTo`). -/
414	def cfinal (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) : CState :=
415	  (crun k (CState.init statics) os).getD (CState.init statics)

419	/-- Combined library states reachable from `CState.init statics` (§47) by `ok` steps of the kernel
420	and of the three libraries (Part XIV; HandlePool v0.4 annex; DS-v1). -/
421	inductive CReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : CState → Prop where
422	  | init : CReach k statics (CState.init statics)
423	  | step {C C' : CState} {o : COp} : CReach k statics C → CRel k C o (.ok C') →

431	/-- A run of `os` from `CState.init statics` (§47) has only `ok` steps and reaches `C`; `C` is
432	library-reachable, and its kernel state is reached by kernel steps O1–O16 and ends of slot contents
433	(§57; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3). -/
434	structure CRunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) (C : CState) : Prop where
435	  /-- Every step is `ok` and the run ends in `C`. -/
436	  run : crun k (CState.init statics) os = some C
437	  /-- `C` is library-reachable. -/
438	  creach : CReach k statics C
439	  /-- The kernel state of `C` is reached by kernel steps and ends of slot contents. -/
440	  xreach : HandlePool.XReach k statics C.kern

442	/-- The run of `os` from `CState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57). -/
443	abbrev CRuns (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) : Prop :=
444	  CRunsTo k statics os (cfinal k statics os)

450	/-- A computed outcome of a projected relation is an outcome of its lift (§58). -/
451	theorem liftR_liftO {σ : Type} {R : Outcome3 σ → Prop} {emb : σ → CState} {o : Outcome3 σ}
452	    (h : R o) : LiftR R emb (liftO emb o) := by
453	  cases o with
454	  | ok x => exact ⟨x, h, rfl⟩
455	  | reject => exact h
456	  | fail => exact h
457	
458	/-- An outcome of a guarded projected step read on combined outcomes (§58). -/
459	theorem liftR_guarded {σ : Type} {p : Prop} [Decidable p] {x : σ} {emb : σ → CState} :
460	    LiftR (Guarded p x) emb (if p then .ok (emb x) else .reject) := by
461	  split
462	  · next h => exact ⟨x, .ok h, rfl⟩
463	  · next h => exact .reject h

465	/-- `firstFree` finds a free slot at its index (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3). -/
466	theorem firstFree_some : ∀ {l : List HandlePool.Slot} {i : Nat} {sl : HandlePool.Slot},
467	    firstFree l = some (i, sl) → l[i]? = some sl ∧ sl.live = false
468	  | [], _, _, h => by simp [firstFree] at h
469	  | x :: l, i, sl, h => by
470	    unfold firstFree at h
471	    split at h
472	    · cases e : firstFree l with
473	      | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
474	      | some p =>
475	        rw [e] at h
476	        simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
477	        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
478	        simpa using firstFree_some e
479	    · next hx =>
480	      simp only [Option.some.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
481	      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
482	      exact ⟨rfl, by simpa using hx⟩
483	
484	/-- When `firstFree` finds nothing, every slot is live (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3). -/
485	theorem firstFree_none : ∀ {l : List HandlePool.Slot}, firstFree l = none →
486	    ∀ sl ∈ l, sl.live = true
487	  | [], _, _, h => by cases h
488	  | x :: l, h, sl, hm => by
489	    unfold firstFree at h
490	    split at h
491	    · next hx =>
492	      cases e : firstFree l with
493	      | none =>
494	        rcases List.mem_cons.1 hm with rfl | hm
495	        · exact hx
496	        · exact firstFree_none e sl hm
497	      | some p => rw [e] at h; cases h
498	    · cases h

500	/-- A computed `writer` writes its destination (§67). -/
501	theorem writer_sound {s : S3} {dst a : Nat} (h : writer s dst = some a) :
502	    Write3Pre s a [dst] := by
503	  have := List.find?_some h
504	  simpa using this

namespace Ern.Lib.HandlePool

open Ern.MemoryModel
open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Library state (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §38, §46) -/

/-- Slot of a pool entry (HandlePool v0.5, D.1: `{place, gen : Nat, live : Bool}`; non-normative
library contract; §38, §46). -/
structure Slot where
  place : Nat
  gen : Nat
  live : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Pool entry `{storage, internal, slots}` with its logical identity (HandlePool v0.5, D.1;
non-normative library contract). The pool value is the place holding `internal` (§46 analogue). -/
structure Pool where
  id : Nat
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  slots : List Slot
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Handle `(poolId, slot, gen)`: data, not an authority (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §37, §89;
non-normative library contract). -/
structure Handle where
  id : Nat
  slot : Nat
  gen : Nat
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Ghost record of a resolution (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; auxiliary information creating no right,
§38): pool identity and `internal`, the companion, the mode, and the entry authorities tagged with
their slot and resolved generation. Read by `unresolve` and by the invariants. -/
structure Res where
  pool : Nat
  internal : Nat
  comp : Nat
  mode : Mode
  entries : List (Nat × Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Library state (§38, §46; HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract): the kernel
state `S₃` and, separately, the pool registry, the next fresh pool identity and the ghost
resolutions. -/
structure PState where
  kern : S3
  pools : List Pool
  nId : Nat
  res : List Res

/-- Initial library state (§47; HandlePool v0.5, D.1): the initial kernel state, an empty
registry. -/
def PState.init (statics : Statics) : PState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0, []⟩

/-- The pool read as an arena entry with nothing available or issued, to reuse `MetaRight` of §36
(HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library contract). -/
def Pool.entry (pl : Pool) : Arena.ArenaEntry := ⟨pl.storage, pl.internal, [], []⟩

/-- Administration right on the pool (§36; HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36, HP5-1;
non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active) and `MetaRight` holds,
exercisable `Modify` over the pool value; no `writeShared` branch. -/
def AdminRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Prop := s.Active pl.internal ∧ Arena.MetaRight s pl.entry

/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; HandlePool v0.5, D.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (AdminRight s pl) := by
  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance

/-- Place of slot `i`, `0` if absent (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract;
§46). -/
def slotPlace (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Nat := ((pl.slots[i]?).map (·.place)).getD 0

/-- The pool with slot `i` replaced (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library contract;
§46). -/
def setSlot (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : Pool := { pl with slots := pl.slots.set i sl }

/-! ## `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §56, §76) -/

/-- The pool registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; HandlePool v0.5, D.1;
non-normative library contract): the `internal` identities of its live pools. -/
def liveInternals (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) : List Nat :=
  (pools.filter fun pl => decide (s.Active pl.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newPool(storage, internal)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library
contract; §56, §76). -/
structure NewPoolPre (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: "reprend les autres obligations applicables de `newArena`"
  (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6, read on the resulting state as v0.1 §76.6 states it). -/
  base : Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1: every leaf of the input storage is `Uninit`. -/
  uninit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.1, §56: `internal` is absent from the pool registry and from every other
  registry of live administrations `others`. -/
  guard : Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewPoolPre` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §56, §76). -/
instance (s : S3) (pools : List Pool) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewPoolPre s pools others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (Arena.NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, s.I l = .uninit) ∧
    Arena.Guard56 (liveInternals s pools :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newPool` (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; non-normative library contract): a pool with the
fresh identity `nId`, one free slot of generation zero per child of the storage, the kernel state
unchanged (§46, §76). -/
def newPoolEff (L : PState) (storage internal : Nat) : PState :=
  { L with
    pools := L.pools ++ [⟨L.nId, storage, internal,
      (kids L.kern.P storage).map fun q => ⟨q, 0, false⟩⟩]
    nId := L.nId + 1 }

/-- `newPool` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.1; §58; non-normative library contract): `ok` or
`reject`; `others` are the other registries of live administrations (§56). -/
def NewPoolStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : PState) :
    Outcome3 PState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewPoolPre L.kern L.pools others storage internal) (newPoolEff L storage internal)

/-! ## `allocSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `allocSlot(pool, dst)` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36;
non-normative library contract). "Apte à recevoir la représentation d'un handle" names no state
component and is not represented. -/
structure AllocSlotStatic (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3, §36: live pool and `MetaRight`. -/
  right : AdminRight s pl
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3: `dst` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3: `dst` is a leaf (the handle is written into "la seule feuille
  `dst`"). -/
  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3 with §67.1: the write of the handle needs exercisable `Modify` over
  `dst`. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3: `dst` is not `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : s.I dst ≠ .init
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, D.3: `dst` holds no active authority. -/
  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True

/-- Decidability of `AllocSlotStatic` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §36, §67). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (AllocSlotStatic s pl dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (AdminRight s pl ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
    s.I dst ≠ .init ∧ ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `allocSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library
contract): the slot becomes live with its generation kept; the handle is written into the leaf
`dst`, which alone becomes `Init` (§67 effect). -/
def allocSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) (dst : Nat) : PState :=
  { L with
    kern := write3Eff L.kern [dst]
    pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i { sl with live := true }) }

/-- The handle written by `allocSlot` for slot `i` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; non-normative library
contract; §37, §89). -/
def slotHandle (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) : Option Handle :=
  (pl.slots[i]?).map fun sl => ⟨pl.id, i, sl.gen⟩

/-- `allocSlot(pool j, dst)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.3; §58; non-normative library
contract): `reject` without the pool or a static precondition; then `fail` when no slot is free;
`ok` on any free slot. -/
inductive AllocSlotStep (j dst : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
  | static {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
      AllocSlotStep j dst L .reject
  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
      (∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, sl.live = true) → AllocSlotStep j dst L .fail
  | ok {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → AllocSlotStatic L.kern pl dst →
      pl.slots[i]? = some sl → sl.live = false →
      AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok (allocSlotEff L j pl i sl dst))

/-! ## `resolve`, `resolveMany` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5, HP5-6) -/

/-- Validity of a handle for pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, D.3, HP5-5, HP5-6, HP5-1''; §89;
non-normative library contract): the pool is live (`internal` active, §46 analogue: a handle of a
dead pool is stale, HP5-5), the handle names the pool, and it designates a live slot at its
generation (a handle of a free entry is stale, HP5-6); a slot index outside the pool designates
nothing. -/
def HandleOK (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Prop :=
  s.Active pl.internal ∧ h.id = pl.id ∧
    OptP (pl.slots[h.slot]?) (fun sl => sl.gen = h.gen ∧ sl.live = true) False

/-- Decidability of `HandleOK` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §89). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (h : Handle) : Decidable (HandleOK s pl h) := by
  unfold HandleOK; infer_instance

/-- Legal exercise of `internal` at mode `m` for the companion (HandlePool v0.5, D.2;
non-normative library contract): the preconditions of the `derive` of the companion from
`internal` over all leaves of the storage (§60). -/
def ResolveRight (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
  DerivePre s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m

/-- Decidability of `ResolveRight` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : Decidable (ResolveRight s pl m) := by
  unfold ResolveRight; infer_instance

/-- State after the companion (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60 effect; non-normative library contract):
authority `|A|`, derived from `internal` at mode `m` over all leaves of the storage. -/
def compS (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  deriveEff s pl.internal (footprint s.P pl.storage) m

/-- Observe derivations from `c`, one per region in order (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: `resolveMany` in
`Observe`; §60; non-normative library contract): each accepted in the state left by the previous
ones. -/
def DerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → Prop
  | [] => True
  | r :: rs => DerivePre s c r .observe ∧ DerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs

/-- Decidability of `DerivesPre` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, §60). -/
instance decDerivesPre (s : S3) (c : Nat) :
    (rs : List (List Nat)) → Decidable (DerivesPre s c rs)
  | [] => isTrue trivial
  | r :: rs =>
    have := decDerivesPre (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs
    inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- Effect of the `Observe` derivations from `c`, in order (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60 effect). -/
def derivesEff (s : S3) (c : Nat) : List (List Nat) → S3
  | [] => s
  | r :: rs => derivesEff (deriveEff s c r .observe) c rs

/-- Entry authorities of a batch from the companion `c` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; non-normative
library contract): `split` (§61) in `Modify`, successive `Observe` derivations (§60) in
`Observe`. -/
def EntriesPre (k : K) : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → Prop
  | .modify, s, c, rs => SplitPre k s c rs
  | .observe, s, c, rs => DerivesPre s c rs

/-- Decidability of `EntriesPre` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60, §61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (m : Mode) (s : S3) (c : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (EntriesPre k m s c rs) := by
  cases m <;> unfold EntriesPre <;> infer_instance

/-- Effect of the entry authorities of a batch (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §60, §61 effects). -/
def entriesEff : Mode → S3 → Nat → List (List Nat) → S3
  | .modify, s, c, rs => splitEff s c rs
  | .observe, s, c, rs => derivesEff s c rs

/-- Regions of the entries designated by a batch: the footprint of each slot (HandlePool v0.5,
D.2; non-normative library contract; §60). -/
def entryRegions (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) : List (List Nat) :=
  hs.map fun h => footprint s.P (slotPlace pl h.slot)

/-- Ghost entries of a batch: the `n`-th entry authority is `c + 1 + n`, for slot and generation of
the `n`-th handle (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; auxiliary, §38). -/
def batchEntries (c : Nat) (hs : List Handle) : List (Nat × Nat × Nat) :=
  mapI (fun i h => (i, h.slot, h.gen)) (c + 1) hs

/-- `resolve(h, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5, HP5-6; §58, §89;
non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool; then `fail` for a handle of a dead
pool, of another pool, stale, absent or free, before the right is checked (HP5-5); then `reject`
without the legal exercise of `internal`; then the companion and the entry authority derived from
it, `reject` when the second derivation is not accepted. -/
inductive ResolveStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveStep j h m L .reject
  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      ResolveStep j h m L .fail
  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ResolveStep j h m L .reject
  | noEntry {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      ResolveRight L.kern pl m → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
      ¬ DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
      ResolveStep j h m L .reject
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      ResolveRight L.kern pl m → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl →
      DerivePre (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m →
      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok { L with
        kern := deriveEff (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (footprint L.kern.P sl.place) m
        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
          [(L.kern.A.length + 1, h.slot, h.gen)]⟩] })

/-- Validity of a batch (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5; non-normative library contract): every
handle is valid (`HandleOK`); pairwise distinct slots in `Modify` only (§58, §89). -/
def BatchOK (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
  (∀ h ∈ hs, HandleOK s pl h) ∧ (m = .modify → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup)

/-- Decidability of `BatchOK` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §58, §89). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) : Decidable (BatchOK s pl hs m) := by
  unfold BatchOK; infer_instance

/-- `resolveMany(hs, m)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2, HP5-5; §58;
non-normative library contract): `reject` without the pool; then an atomic `fail` for an invalid
batch, before the right is checked (HP5-5); then `reject` without the legal exercise of
`internal`; then one companion and the entry authorities (`EntriesPre`), `reject` when they are
not accepted. -/
inductive ResolveManyStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode) (L : PState) :
    Outcome3 PState → Prop where
  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .fail
  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
      ¬ ResolveRight L.kern pl m → ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
  | noEntries {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m →
      ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
      ¬ EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L .reject
  | ok {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → BatchOK L.kern pl hs m → ResolveRight L.kern pl m →
      EntriesPre k m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs) →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok { L with
        kern := entriesEff m (compS L.kern pl m) L.kern.A.length (entryRegions L.kern pl hs)
        res := L.res ++ [⟨pl.id, pl.internal, L.kern.A.length, m,
          batchEntries L.kern.A.length hs⟩] })

/-! ## `unresolve` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2) -/

/-- Releases the authorities of a list in order (§62); `none` as soon as one release is not
accepted (HandlePool v0.5, D.2: "Les règles de `release` … restent applicables"). -/
def releaseAll : S3 → List Nat → Option S3
  | s, [] => some s
  | s, a :: l => if ReleasePre s a then releaseAll (releaseEff s a) l else none

/-- The resolution of companion `c` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; ghost lookup, §38). -/
def findRes (L : PState) (c : Nat) : Option Res := L.res.find? fun r => r.comp == c

/-- Authorities released by `unresolve` of `r` (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; non-normative library
contract): the entry authorities still active, then the companion (§62). -/
def unresolveList (s : S3) (r : Res) : List Nat :=
  ((r.entries.map (·.1)).filter fun a => decide (s.Active a)) ++ [r.comp]

/-- `unresolve(c)` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.2; §58; non-normative library contract): the
releases of `unresolveList`; `reject` when one is not accepted or `c` is no companion. -/
inductive UnresolveStep (c : Nat) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
  | none : findRes L c = none → UnresolveStep c L .reject
  | reject {r : Res} : findRes L c = some r → releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = none →
      UnresolveStep c L .reject
  | ok {r : Res} {s' : S3} : findRes L c = some r →
      releaseAll L.kern (unresolveList L.kern r) = some s' →
      UnresolveStep c L (.ok { L with kern := s' })

/-! ## `freeSlot` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 as amended by HP5-1, HP5-1', HP5-1'') -/

/-- No active strict descendant of the `internal` of pool `pl` covers a leaf of place `q`
(HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1 as amended by HP5-1': "aucune autorité active, descendante stricte de
internal de ce pool, ne couvre l'entrée"; §42: descendants along the current origin chain, which
covers the reanchoring of §73.4 onto `internal`; non-normative library contract). -/
def NoInternalDesc (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active x → pl.internal ∈ s.ancs x →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp x, l ∉ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `NoInternalDesc` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1'; §42). -/
instance (s : S3) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (NoInternalDesc s pl q) := by
  unfold NoInternalDesc; infer_instance

/-- Content conditions of `freeSlot` on slot place `q` of pool `pl` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1,
HP5-1'; non-normative library contract; §41, §42). -/
structure FreeContentOK (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1: no leaf of the entry is `Init`; each is `Uninit` or `Moved`
  (§41). -/
  notInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init
  /-- HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1': no active strict descendant of `internal` of this pool covers a
  leaf of the entry (§42). -/
  noDesc : NoInternalDesc L.kern pl q

/-- Decidability of `FreeContentOK` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1, HP5-1'; §41, §42). -/
instance (L : PState) (pl : Pool) (q : Nat) : Decidable (FreeContentOK L pl q) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ footprint L.kern.P q, L.kern.I l ≠ .init) ∧ NoInternalDesc L.kern pl q)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `freeSlot` on slot `i` of pool `j` (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-1; non-normative library
contract): the slot becomes free and its generation is incremented; there is no end-of-use effect
and the kernel state is unchanged (§36: the library adds no rights to the kernel). -/
def freeSlotEff (L : PState) (j : Nat) (pl : Pool) (i : Nat) (sl : Slot) : PState :=
  { L with pools := L.pools.set j (setSlot pl i ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) }

/-- `freeSlot(h)` on pool `j` as a relation (HandlePool v0.5, D.3 corrected by §36, HP5-1; outcome
order of HP5-1'' (Q5 extended to `freeSlot`); §58, §89; non-normative library contract): `reject`
without the pool; then `fail` for a handle of a dead pool, of another pool, stale, absent or free,
before the right is checked; then `reject` without the administration right (live pool and
`MetaRight`); then `reject` unless the content conditions hold (`FreeContentOK`); then `ok`. -/
inductive FreeSlotStep (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (L : PState) : Outcome3 PState → Prop where
  | noPool : L.pools[j]? = none → FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
  | fail {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → ¬ HandleOK L.kern pl h → FreeSlotStep j h L .fail
  | noRight {pl : Pool} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h → ¬ AdminRight L.kern pl →
      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
  | noContent {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      AdminRight L.kern pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → ¬ FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep j h L .reject
  | ok {pl : Pool} {sl : Slot} : L.pools[j]? = some pl → HandleOK L.kern pl h →
      AdminRight L.kern pl → pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl → FreeContentOK L pl sl.place →
      FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok (freeSlotEff L j pl h.slot sl))

/-! ## Library runs (HandlePool v0.5; §38, §46, §47) -/

/-- One `ok` step of a library run (HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract): a kernel
step O1–O16 of non-administrative code, the registry unchanged, or an accepted pool operation
(§58). -/
inductive PStep (k : K) : PState → PState → Prop where
  | kernel {L : PState} {s' : S3} : KStep k L.kern s' → PStep k L { L with kern := s' }
  | newPool {L L' : PState} {others : List (List Nat)} {st i : Nat} :
      NewPoolStep others st i L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | allocSlot {L L' : PState} {j dst : Nat} : AllocSlotStep j dst L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | resolve {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode} :
      ResolveStep j h m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | resolveMany {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | unresolve {L L' : PState} {c : Nat} : UnresolveStep c L (.ok L') → PStep k L L'
  | freeSlot {L L' : PState} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} : FreeSlotStep j h L (.ok L') →
      PStep k L L'

/-- Library states reachable from the initial library state (§47) by library steps
(HandlePool v0.5; non-normative library contract). -/
inductive PReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : PState → Prop where
  | init : PReach k statics (PState.init statics)
  | step {L L' : PState} : PReach k statics L → PStep k L L' → PReach k statics L'

/-! ## Kernel side of the pool operations (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7) -/

/-- Finite sequences of kernel steps O1–O16 (§57, §58; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
inductive KSeq (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | refl (s : S3) : KSeq k s s
  | tail {s s₁ s₂ : S3} : KSeq k s s₁ → KStep k s₁ s₂ → KSeq k s s₂

/-- Sequences of kernel steps compose (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
theorem KSeq.trans {k : K} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} (h₁ : KSeq k s₁ s₂) (h₂ : KSeq k s₂ s₃) :
    KSeq k s₁ s₃ := by
  induction h₂ with
  | refl => exact h₁
  | tail _ hs ih => exact .tail ih hs

/-- One kernel step is a sequence (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7). -/
theorem KSeq.single {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : KSeq k s s' := .tail (.refl s) h

/-- Kernel reachability (§57) is closed under sequences of kernel steps (HandlePool v0.5,
HP5-7). -/
theorem KSeq.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s)
    (h : KSeq k s s') : Reachable k statics s' := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hr
  | tail _ hs ih => exact .step ih hs

/-- `releaseAll` is a sequence of `release` steps (§62; HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
theorem releaseAll_kseq {k : K} : ∀ {s s' : S3} {l : List Nat}, releaseAll s l = some s' →
    KSeq k s s'
  | s, s', [], h => by simp only [releaseAll, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact .refl s
  | s, s', a :: l, h => by
    simp only [releaseAll] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i hpre
      exact (KSeq.single (.release (Guarded.ok hpre))).trans (releaseAll_kseq h)
    · cases h

/-- The `Observe` derivations of `resolveMany` are a sequence of `derive` steps (§60;
HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
theorem derives_kseq {k : K} {c : Nat} : ∀ {s : S3} {rs : List (List Nat)}, DerivesPre s c rs →
    KSeq k s (derivesEff s c rs)
  | s, [], _ => .refl s
  | _, _ :: _, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok h₁))).trans (derives_kseq h₂)

/-- The entry authorities of `resolveMany` are a `split` (§61) or a sequence of `derive` steps
(§60) (HandlePool v0.5, D.2). -/
theorem entries_kseq {k : K} {m : Mode} {s : S3} {c : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)}
    (h : EntriesPre k m s c rs) : KSeq k s (entriesEff m s c rs) := by
  cases m with
  | modify => exact KSeq.single (.split (Guarded.ok h))
  | observe => exact derives_kseq h

/-- Under `KInv` (§57), an authority `a` exercisable in `Modify` with effective `Modify` over every
leaf of a usable place `q` satisfies the preconditions of an ordinary write (§67) of any leaves of
`q` (HandlePool v0.5, D.3: the write of the handle; HP5-3: the write of the pool value). -/
theorem write_of_right {s : S3} (hk : KInv s) {q a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hu : s.Usable q)
    (hex : s.ExercisableAt a .modify)
    (hall : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) .modify)
    (hls : ∀ l ∈ ls, l ∈ footprint s.P q) : Write3Pre s a ls := by
  refine ⟨fun l hl => ⟨q, List.mem_range.2 hu.lt, hu, hls l hl⟩, hex,
    fun l hl => Arena.allows_modify_iff.1 (hall l (hls l hl)),
    fun l hl b _ hb => effective_exclusive hk.2.1.1.1 (Ne.symm hb)
      (Arena.allows_modify_iff.1 (hall l (hls l hl))), fun l hl => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨-, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 (hls l hl)
  have hul : s.Usable l := usable_of_partOf hk.1 (l + 1) l q (Nat.lt_succ_self l) hlq hu
  exact fun q' _ hq' x hx => hk.2.1.1.2.2.1 q' (usable_of_part hk.1 hq' hul) x hx

/-- What a pool step is on the kernel side (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7; §57, §58): under `KInv`, every
library step is a finite sequence of accepted kernel steps O1–O16: `newPool` and `freeSlot` none
(the identity, HP5-1), `allocSlot` one `write` (§67), `resolve` two `derive` (§60), `resolveMany`
one `derive` then one `split` (§61) or one `derive` per handle, `unresolve` `release` steps
(§62). -/
theorem pstep_kernel {k : K} {L L' : PState} (hk : KInv L.kern) (h : PStep k L L') :
    KSeq k L.kern L'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hs => exact KSeq.single hs
  | newPool hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact .refl _
  | allocSlot hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst _ _ =>
      obtain ⟨a, -, hex, hall⟩ := hst.dstRight
      exact KSeq.single (.write (a := a) (Guarded.ok (write_of_right hk hst.dstUsable hex hall
        fun l hl => by
          rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hl]
          exact mem_footprint.2 ⟨hst.dstUsable.lt, hst.dstLeaf, hst.dstUsable.lt, .inl rfl⟩)))
  | resolve hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ hR _ hE =>
      exact (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).tail (.derive (Guarded.ok hE))
  | resolveMany hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ hR hE => exact (KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).trans (entries_kseq hE)
  | unresolve hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hr => exact releaseAll_kseq hr
  | freeSlot hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok => exact .refl _

/-- The kernel state of every library-reachable state is reachable from `S3.init statics` by
kernel steps O1–O16 (§57; HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7), under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47),
which give `KInv` on the kernel side of the run (`Access.reachable_kinv`). -/
theorem pReach_reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics)
    {L : PState} (h : PReach k statics L) : Reachable k statics L.kern := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ hs ih => exact (pstep_kernel (reachable_kinv hdd hst ih) hs).reachable ih

/-- The guarantee of §57 on the kernel side of library runs (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7, O5.g;
non-normative library contract): every kernel state of a library-reachable state satisfies
`KInv`. -/
def KernelGuarantee (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop := ∀ L, PReach k statics L → KInv L.kern

/-- `KernelGuarantee` holds under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47) (HandlePool v0.5, HP5-7;
§57): the kernel state of a library-reachable state is kernel-reachable (`pReach_reachable`). -/
theorem kernel_guarantee {k : K} {statics : Statics} (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    KernelGuarantee k statics :=
  fun _ h => reachable_kinv hdd hst (pReach_reachable hdd hst h)

/-! ## Helper lemmas (lists, chains, effects) -/

/-- An optional value satisfying a predicate with default `False` exists (§38; HandlePool v0.5). -/
theorem optP_false_iff {α : Type} {o : Option α} {P : α → Prop} :
    OptP o P False ↔ ∃ y, o = some y ∧ P y := by
  cases o with

import Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-!
# Corpus runner (test module)

A computable executor for the corpus cases of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: the
kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75) and the arena operations O17–O19 of Part XIV (§76–§78), over
the library state of `Ern.MemoryModel.Arena` (§46: the kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the arena
registry). This module is a test module: no model module imports it.

* `Op`: one constructor per operation, with its arguments.
* `lstep k L o`: the outcome (§58) of `o` from `L`, computed from the decidable preconditions.
* `OpRel k L o`: the relation of the operation: the kernel relation `XStep` (§60–§75) with the
  registry unchanged; `NewArenaStep`, `IssueD`, `ResetD` (Part XIV) for the arena operations.
* `lstep_sound`: the computed outcome is an outcome of the relation, `ok`, `reject` and `fail`
  alike; `lstep_ok`: an `ok` step is a library step `LStep`.
* `lrun`, `final`, `RunsTo`: a run from `LState.init statics` (§47) whose steps are all `ok` reaches
  a library-reachable state (`LReach`) whose kernel state is reachable (`Reachable`, §57).

`newArena` consults the arena registry and no other registry (§56: `others = []`): the library
states of these runs hold no administration other than arenas.
-/

namespace Ern.Corpus

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

/-! ## Test contracts (§48, §80) -/

/-- A test contract `K` given by lists (§48): the `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone` and
`Deallocable` sets, and the `FreeCompat` pairs; `ExternalDone` lists identities of dynamic pinning
obligations (§75). Nothing is declared disjoint; every allocation request is satisfiable. -/
structure KD where
  shared : List Nat := []
  pinned : List Nat := []
  done : List Nat := []
  dealloc : List Nat := []
  compat : List (Nat × Nat) := []

/-- The contract `K` (§48) described by a `KD`. -/
def KD.toK (d : KD) : K :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => False, (· ∈ d.shared), (· ∈ d.pinned), (· ∈ d.done), (· ∈ d.dealloc),
    fun p a => (p, a) ∈ d.compat, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Decidability of `DeclaredDisjoint` for a test contract (§48). -/
instance (d : KD) : ∀ r r', Decidable (d.toK.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `SharedMutable` for a test contract (§48). -/
instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.SharedMutable :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ d.shared))
/-- Decidability of `Pinned` for a test contract (§48). -/
instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.Pinned :=
  fun l => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (l ∈ d.pinned))
/-- Decidability of `ExternalDone`, on obligation identities, for a test contract (§48, §75). -/
instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.ExternalDone :=
  fun p => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (p ∈ d.done))
/-- Decidability of `Deallocable` for a test contract (§48). -/
instance (d : KD) : DecidablePred d.toK.Deallocable :=
  fun p => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (p ∈ d.dealloc))
/-- Decidability of `FreeCompat` for a test contract (§48). -/
instance (d : KD) : ∀ p a, Decidable (d.toK.FreeCompat p a) :=
  fun p a => inferInstanceAs (Decidable ((p, a) ∈ d.compat))
/-- Decidability of `Satisfiable` for a test contract (§48). -/
instance (d : KD) : ∀ p ls s, Decidable (d.toK.Satisfiable p ls s) :=
  fun _ _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)

/-- Test contracts satisfy `DDSound` (§61, §80): nothing is declared disjoint. -/
theorem KD.ddSound (d : KD) : DDSound d.toK := fun _ _ h => h.elim

/-! ## Operations and outcomes (§58, §60–§78) -/

/-- An operation of a corpus run: the kernel operations O1–O16 (§60–§75) and the arena operations
O17–O19 (§76–§78), with their arguments; `unpin` takes the identity of a dynamic pinning
obligation, its index in `S3.pins` (§74, §75). -/
inductive Op where
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  | release (a : Nat)
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | exit
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | pin (p : Nat)
  | unpin (o : Nat)
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  | alloc (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  | store (a p : Nat)
  | newArena (storage internal : Nat)
  | issue (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
  | reset (i : Nat)

/-- The verdict of an outcome (§58): `ok`, `reject` or `fail`, without the state. -/
inductive Verdict where
  | ok
  | reject
  | fail
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- The verdict of an outcome (§58). -/
def verdictOf {σ : Type} : Outcome3 σ → Verdict
  | .ok _ => .ok
  | .reject => .reject
  | .fail => .fail

/-- A kernel relation (§60–§75) read on library outcomes: the kernel outcome, with the arena
registry `A` unchanged on `ok` (Part XIV: kernel steps of non-administrative code). -/
def KRel (R : Outcome3 S3 → Prop) (A : List ArenaEntry) : Outcome3 LState → Prop
  | .ok L' => R (.ok L'.kern) ∧ L'.arenas = A
  | .reject => R .reject
  | .fail => R .fail

/-- The relation of operation `o` from `L` (§60–§78): the kernel relation of O1–O16 with the
registry unchanged; `NewArenaStep` with no other registry (§76, §56), the derived `IssueD` (§77)
and `ResetD` (§78). -/
def OpRel (k : K) (L : LState) : Op → Outcome3 LState → Prop
  | .derive src r m => KRel (DeriveStep src r m L.kern) L.arenas
  | .split src rs => KRel (SplitStep k src rs L.kern) L.arenas
  | .release a => KRel (ReleaseStep a L.kern) L.arenas
  | .transfer src dst => KRel (TransferStep k src dst L.kern) L.arenas
  | .depend q x => KRel (DependStep q x L.kern) L.arenas
  | .enter ps ls => KRel (EnterStep ps ls L.kern) L.arenas
  | .exit => KRel (ExitStep k L.kern) L.arenas
  | .read a ls => KRel (Read3Step a ls L.kern) L.arenas
  | .write a ls => KRel (Write3Step a ls L.kern) L.arenas
  | .writeShared a ls => KRel (WriteSharedStep k a ls L.kern) L.arenas
  | .pin p => KRel (PinStep p L.kern) L.arenas
  | .unpin o => KRel (UnpinStep k o L.kern) L.arenas
  | .endUse p => KRel (EndUseStep k p L.kern) L.arenas
  | .free p auth => KRel (FreeStep k p auth L.kern) L.arenas
  | .alloc pr ow ls => KRel (AllocStep k pr ow ls L.kern) L.arenas
  | .store a p => KRel (StoreStep a p L.kern) L.arenas
  | .newArena st i => NewArenaStep [] st i L
  | .issue i r d => IssueD k i r d L
  | .reset i => ResetD i L

/-! ## Executor -/

section Exec
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A guarded kernel step (§58) on a library state: `ok` with the effect and the registry
unchanged when the preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
def kg (L : LState) (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (s : S3) : Outcome3 LState :=
  if p then .ok ⟨s, L.arenas⟩ else .reject

/-- The computed outcome of operation `o` from `L` (§58, §60–§78). `issue` follows `IssueD`
(static checks, availability `fail`, `split`, `store`); `reset` follows `ResetD` (`derive`,
`release`, §78.3). -/
def lstep (L : LState) : Op → Outcome3 LState
  | .derive src r m => kg L (DerivePre L.kern src r m) (deriveEff L.kern src r m)
  | .split src rs => kg L (SplitPre k L.kern src rs) (splitEff L.kern src rs)
  | .release a => kg L (ReleasePre L.kern a) (releaseEff L.kern a)
  | .transfer src dst => kg L (TransferPre k L.kern src dst) (transferEff L.kern src dst)
  | .depend q x => kg L (DependPre L.kern q x) (dependEff L.kern q x)
  | .enter ps ls => kg L (EnterPre L.kern ps ls) (enterEff L.kern ps ls)
  | .exit => kg L (ExitPre k L.kern) (exitEff L.kern)
  | .read a ls => kg L (Read3Pre L.kern a ls) L.kern
  | .write a ls => kg L (Write3Pre L.kern a ls) (write3Eff L.kern ls)
  | .writeShared a ls => kg L (WriteSharedPre k L.kern a ls) (write3Eff L.kern ls)
  | .pin p => kg L (PinPre L.kern p) (pinEff L.kern p)
  | .unpin o => kg L (UnpinPre k L.kern o) (unpinEff L.kern o)
  | .endUse p => kg L (EndUsePre k L.kern p) (endUseEff L.kern p)
  | .free p auth => kg L (FreePre k L.kern p auth) (freeEff L.kern p)
  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
    if AllocStatic k L.kern pr ow ls then
      if k.Satisfiable pr ls L.kern then .ok ⟨allocEff L.kern ow ls, L.arenas⟩ else .fail
    else .reject
  | .store a p => kg L (StorePre L.kern a p) (storeEff L.kern a p)
  | .newArena st i =>
    if NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas [] st i then .ok (newArenaEff L st i) else .reject
  | .issue i r d =>
    match L.arenas[i]? with
    | none => .reject
    | some E =>
      if IssueStatic L.kern E r d then
        if Avail E r then
          if SplitPre k L.kern E.internal [r] then
            if StorePre (splitEff L.kern E.internal [r]) L.kern.A.length d then
              .ok ⟨storeEff (splitEff L.kern E.internal [r]) L.kern.A.length d,
                L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E r)⟩
            else .reject
          else .reject
        else .fail
      else .reject
  | .reset i =>
    match L.arenas[i]? with
    | none => .reject
    | some E =>
      if DerivePre L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify then
        if ReleasePre (deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)
            L.kern.A.length then
          if ResetNoDeps L.kern E then
            .ok ⟨releaseEff (deriveEff L.kern E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify)
              L.kern.A.length, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩
          else .reject
        else .reject
      else .reject

/-- The state after `o` from `L` when it is `ok`; `L` otherwise (§58). -/
def next (L : LState) (o : Op) : LState :=
  match lstep k L o with
  | .ok L' => L'
  | _ => L

/-- The state reached by the operations `os` from `L` when every step is `ok` (§58); `none` as soon
as a step is not `ok`. -/
def lrun (L : LState) : List Op → Option LState
  | [] => some L
  | o :: os =>
    match lstep k L o with
    | .ok L' => lrun L' os
    | _ => none

/-- The state reached by `os` from `LState.init statics` (§47); `LState.init statics` when a step is
not `ok` (used only under `(lrun …).isSome = true`, see `runsTo`). -/
def final (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : LState :=
  (lrun k (LState.init statics) os).getD (LState.init statics)

/-- A run of `os` from `LState.init statics` (§47) has only `ok` steps and reaches `L`; `L` is
library-reachable (Part XIV) and its kernel state is reachable (§57). -/
structure RunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) (L : LState) : Prop where
  /-- Every step of the run is `ok` and the run ends in `L`. -/
  run : lrun k (LState.init statics) os = some L
  /-- `L` is library-reachable (Part XIV, §46). -/
  lreach : LReach k statics L
  /-- The kernel state of `L` is reachable from `S3.init statics` by O1–O16 (§57). -/
  reach : Reachable k statics L.kern

/-- The run of `os` from `LState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57, Part XIV). -/
abbrev Runs (statics : Statics) (os : List Op) : Prop :=
  RunsTo k statics os (final k statics os)

end Exec

/-! ## Soundness -/

/-- An `ok` outcome of a relation of `OpRel` is a library step (Part XIV, §57): a kernel step
O1–O16 with the registry unchanged, `newArena`, the derived `issue` or the derived `reset`. -/
theorem opRel_ok {k : K} {L L' : LState} : ∀ {o : Op}, OpRel k L o (.ok L') → LStep k L L'
  | .derive .., h | .split .., h | .release .., h | .transfer .., h | .depend .., h
  | .enter .., h | .exit, h | .read .., h | .write .., h | .writeShared .., h | .pin .., h
  | .unpin .., h | .endUse .., h | .free .., h | .alloc .., h | .store .., h => by
    obtain ⟨h, e⟩ := h
    have hL : L' = ⟨L'.kern, L.arenas⟩ := by rw [← e]
    rw [hL]
    first
      | exact .kernel (.derive h) | exact .kernel (.split h) | exact .kernel (.release h)
      | exact .kernel (.transfer h) | exact .kernel (.depend h) | exact .kernel (.enter h)
      | exact .kernel (.exit h) | exact .kernel (.read h) | exact .kernel (.write h)
      | exact .kernel (.writeShared h) | exact .kernel (.pin h) | exact .kernel (.unpin h)
      | exact .kernel (.endUse h) | exact .kernel (.free h) | exact .kernel (.alloc h)
      | exact .kernel (.store h)
  | .newArena .., h => .newArena h
  | .issue .., h => .issue h
  | .reset .., h => .reset h

section Sound
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A guarded kernel step computed by `kg` is an outcome of its relation (§58). -/
theorem kg_sound {L : LState} {p : Prop} [Decidable p] {s : S3} :
    KRel (Guarded p s) L.arenas (kg L p s) := by
  unfold kg
  split
  · next h => exact ⟨.ok h, rfl⟩
  · next h => exact .reject h

/-- **Step soundness** (§58, §60–§78): the computed outcome of `o` from `L` is an outcome of the
relation of `o`, `ok`, `reject` and `fail` alike. -/
theorem lstep_sound (L : LState) (o : Op) : OpRel k L o (lstep k L o) := by
  cases o with
  | derive => exact kg_sound
  | split => exact kg_sound
  | release => exact kg_sound
  | transfer => exact kg_sound
  | depend => exact kg_sound
  | enter => exact kg_sound
  | exit => exact kg_sound
  | read => exact kg_sound
  | write => exact kg_sound
  | writeShared => exact kg_sound
  | pin => exact kg_sound
  | unpin => exact kg_sound
  | endUse => exact kg_sound
  | free => exact kg_sound
  | store => exact kg_sound
  | alloc pr ow ls =>
    show KRel (AllocStep k pr ow ls L.kern) L.arenas _
    dsimp only [lstep]
    split
    · next h =>
      split
      · next hs => exact ⟨.ok h hs, rfl⟩
      · next hs => exact .fail h hs
    · next h => exact .reject h
  | newArena st i =>
    show NewArenaStep [] st i L _
    dsimp only [lstep]
    split
    · next h => exact .ok h
    · next h => exact .reject h
  | issue i r d =>
    show IssueD k i r d L _
    dsimp only [lstep]
    split
    · next hE => exact .noEntry hE
    · next E hE =>
      split
      · next h1 =>
        split
        · next h2 =>
          split
          · next h3 =>
            split
            · next h4 => exact .ok hE h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.ok h4)
            · next h4 => exact .store hE h1 h2 (.ok h3) (.reject h4)
          · next h3 => exact .split hE h1 h2 (.reject h3)
        · next h2 => exact .fail hE h1 h2
      · next h1 => exact .static hE h1
  | reset i =>
    show ResetD i L _
    dsimp only [lstep]
    split
    · next hE => exact .noEntry hE
    · next E hE =>
      split
      · next h1 =>
        split
        · next h2 =>
          split
          · next h3 => exact .ok hE (.ok h1) (.ok h2) h3
          · next h3 => exact .contract hE (.ok h1) (.ok h2) h3
        · next h2 => exact .release hE (.ok h1) (.reject h2)
      · next h1 => exact .derive hE (.reject h1)

/-- An `ok` computed step is a library step (Part XIV, §58). -/
theorem lstep_ok {L L' : LState} {o : Op} (h : lstep k L o = .ok L') : LStep k L L' :=
  opRel_ok (h ▸ lstep_sound L o)

/-- A run whose steps are all `ok`, from a library-reachable state, ends in a library-reachable
state (Part XIV, §46). -/
theorem lrun_reach {statics : Statics} :
    ∀ {L L' : LState} {os : List Op}, LReach k statics L → lrun k L os = some L' →
      LReach k statics L'
  | _, _, [], hL, h => by cases h; exact hL
  | L, _, o :: os, hL, h => by
    unfold lrun at h
    cases hs : lstep k L o with
    | ok L₁ => rw [hs] at h; exact lrun_reach (.step hL (lstep_ok hs)) h
    | reject => rw [hs] at h; cases h
    | fail => rw [hs] at h; cases h

/-- **Run soundness** (§47, §57, Part XIV): when every step of `os` from `LState.init statics` is
`ok`, the run reaches `final k statics os`, which is library-reachable and whose kernel state is
reachable by O1–O16. -/
theorem runsTo {statics : Statics} {os : List Op}
    (h : (lrun k (LState.init statics) os).isSome = true) : Runs k statics os := by
  have hr : lrun k (LState.init statics) os = some (final k statics os) := by
    unfold final
    cases e : lrun k (LState.init statics) os with
    | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
    | some L => rfl
  have hl := lrun_reach .init hr
  exact ⟨hr, hl, hl.ng.reachable⟩

/-- A computed `reject` is a `reject` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
theorem rejects {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .reject) :
    OpRel k L o .reject := by
  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
  revert hs h
  cases lstep k L o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | fail => intro h; cases h

/-- A computed `fail` is a `fail` outcome of the relation (§58). -/
theorem fails {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .fail) :
    OpRel k L o .fail := by
  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
  revert hs h
  cases lstep k L o with
  | ok => intro h; cases h
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro _ hs; exact hs

/-- A computed `ok` is the `ok` outcome of the relation to `next k L o` (§58). -/
theorem oks {L : LState} {o : Op} (h : verdictOf (lstep k L o) = .ok) :
    OpRel k L o (.ok (next k L o)) := by
  have hs := lstep_sound (k := k) L o
  unfold next
  revert hs h
  cases lstep k L o with
  | ok => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro h; cases h

end Sound

end Ern.Corpus
