/-- A stack (DS-v2, non-normative; library state, §38, §46): administered storage, `internal`
authority held by the stack value (§36), ordered cells (the leaves of the storage at creation),
top (the cells at positions `≥ top` are available), issued blocks (oldest first), and the ordered
list of live marks (DS-v2: "the stack keeps the ordered list of live marks"). -/
structure Stack where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  cells : List Nat
  top : Nat
  blocks : List Blk
  marks : List Mark
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- State of the stack library (DS-v2, non-normative; §38: administrative states of library
abstractions are separate from `S₃`): the kernel state, the stack registry (a stack is identified
by its index; stacks are never removed) and the next fresh mark identifier. -/
structure DState where
  kern : S3
  stacks : List Stack
  fresh : Nat

/-- Initial state (§47: the kernel's initial state; the library registry starts empty; DS-v2,
non-normative: no mark identifier given out). -/
def DState.init (statics : Statics) : DState := ⟨S3.init statics, [], 0⟩

/-- The `n` cells from position `b` of the stack, leaves of the administered storage (§46; DS-v2,
non-normative). -/
def cellsOf (st : Stack) (b n : Nat) : List Nat := (st.cells.drop b).take n

/-- The cells above mark `m` (DS-v2, non-normative, "a cell above m", DS2-4: every cell at a
position `≥ m.top`; §46 available leaves): `rewind m` returns those below the current top to
available, the others already are. -/
def above (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : List Nat := st.cells.drop m.top

/-- The stack seen as an administration entry (§46, §36; DS-v2, non-normative): storage,
`internal`, available cells (positions `≥ top`) and issued blocks. Used for `MetaRight` and the
static checks of the derived `issue`, which read only the storage and `internal`. -/
def Stack.entry (st : Stack) : ArenaEntry :=
  ⟨st.storage, st.internal, st.cells.drop st.top,
    st.blocks.map fun x => (cellsOf st x.base x.size, x.auth)⟩

/-- The block of the stack whose authority is `b` (§46 issuances; DS-v2, non-normative). -/
def Stack.block (st : Stack) (b : Nat) : Option Blk := st.blocks.find? fun y => decide (y.auth = b)

/-- A live mark of stack `j` (DS-v2, non-normative: a mark that is neither dead nor foreign; it
decides the `fail` case of `rewind`, §58): the stack is live (`internal` is active, §46 read for a
stack; DS2-3: a dead stack invalidates its marks), the mark names stack `j` and it belongs to the
list of live marks of the stack. -/
def LiveMark (s : S3) (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Prop :=
  s.Active st.internal ∧ m.stack = j ∧ m ∈ st.marks

/-- Decidability of `LiveMark` (§58; DS-v2). -/
instance (s : S3) (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Decidable (LiveMark s j st m) := by
  unfold LiveMark; infer_instance

/-- The administrative right of §36 for a stack (DS-v2, non-normative, with §36 and §46 read for a
stack): the stack is live (`internal` is active) and `MetaRight`, `Modify` exercisable on the stack
value, the place holding `internal`. -/
def AdminRight (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Prop := s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRight s st.entry

/-- Decidability of `AdminRight` (§36; DS-v2). -/
instance (s : S3) (st : Stack) : Decidable (AdminRight s st) := by
  unfold AdminRight; infer_instance

/-! ## `newStack` and the guard of §56 -/

/-- The stack registry as a registry of live administrations (§56; DS-v2, non-normative): the
`internal` identities of its live stacks. -/
def stackInternals (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) : List Nat :=
  (stacks.filter fun st => decide (s.Active st.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newStack(storage, internal)` (DS-v2, non-normative; §56): those of `newArena`
other than its guard (`NewArenaBase`, §76.1–§76.3, §76.5 and §76.6 read for a stack), and the guard
of §56 over the stack registry and every other registry of live administrations `others`. -/
structure NewStackPre (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5, §76.6, read for a stack (DS-v2). -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §56: no live administration of any registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewStackPre` (§56; DS-v2). -/
instance (s : S3) (stacks : List Stack) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewStackPre s stacks others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (stackInternals s stacks :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newStack` (DS-v2, non-normative; §36: registration adds no rights): a stack whose
cells are the leaves of the storage, top 0, no block, no mark; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newStackEff (D : DState) (storage internal : Nat) : DState :=
  { D with stacks := D.stacks ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint D.kern.P storage, 0, [], []⟩] }

/-- `newStack` as a relation (DS-v2, non-normative; §56, §58): `ok` or `reject`. -/
def NewStackStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (D : DState) :
    Outcome3 DState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewStackPre D.kern D.stacks others storage internal) (newStackEff D storage internal)

/-! ## `push` (DS-v2: the derived `issue`, Part XIV, §77) -/

/-- Metadata after `push` (DS-v2, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
cells leave the available part (the top rises by `size`), the block is recorded. -/
def pushMeta (st : Stack) (size a dst : Nat) : Stack :=
  { st with top := st.top + size, blocks := st.blocks ++ [⟨st.top, size, a, dst⟩] }

/-- `push(j, size, dst)` (DS-v2, non-normative: "push uses the derived issue"): the derived `issue`
of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the `size` cells at the top into `dst`, on the stack seen as an
entry: its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2, with `MetaRight` of §36), then `fail`, the
state unchanged, when fewer than `size` cells are left (availability, §77.4; DS-v2, Q11 (a)),
then `split` of `internal` on the cells (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh identity `|A|`, into
`dst` (O8). -/
inductive PushStep (k : K) (j size dst : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      ¬ IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
  | fail {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
      ¬ st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length → PushStep k j size dst D .fail
  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern .reject →
      PushStep k j size dst D .reject
  | store {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → PushStep k j size dst D .reject
  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      IssueStatic D.kern st.entry (cellsOf st st.top size) dst →
      st.top + size ≤ st.cells.length →
      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st st.top size] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep D.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      PushStep k j size dst D
        (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (pushMeta st size D.kern.A.length dst), D.fresh⟩)

/-! ## `mark` (DS-v2) -/

/-- Metadata after `mark` (DS-v2, non-normative; library metadata, §36, §38): a mark naming stack
`j`, with the fresh identifier `fresh` and the current top, is appended to the live marks. -/
def markMeta (j : Nat) (st : Stack) (fresh : Nat) : Stack :=
  { st with marks := st.marks ++ [⟨j, fresh, st.top⟩] }

/-- `mark(j)` (DS-v2, non-normative; §58 outcomes): `reject` on a missing stack; `reject` without
the administrative right of §36 (DS2-1); otherwise `ok`, metadata only (no right created, §36), the
identifier is fresh. -/
inductive MarkStep (j : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → MarkStep j D .reject
  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ AdminRight D.kern st → MarkStep j D .reject
  | ok {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → AdminRight D.kern st →
      MarkStep j D (.ok ⟨D.kern, D.stacks.set j (markMeta j st D.fresh), D.fresh + 1⟩)

/-- `mark_rejects_without_right` (DS-v2, non-normative, DS2-1: `mark` requires `AdminRight` on the
stack, else `reject`; §36, §58): on an existing stack without the administrative right of §36,
`mark` has the outcome `reject` and no other. -/
theorem mark_rejects_without_right {j : Nat} {D : DState} {st : Stack}
    (hst : D.stacks[j]? = some st) (ha : ¬ AdminRight D.kern st) :
    MarkStep j D .reject ∧ ∀ o, MarkStep j D o → o = .reject := by
  refine ⟨.static hst ha, fun o ho => ?_⟩
  cases ho with
  | noStack => rfl
  | static => rfl
  | ok h ha' => rw [hst] at h; cases h; exact absurd ha' ha

/-! ## `rewind` (DS-v2) -/

/-- Metadata after `rewind m` (DS-v2, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §78 on §46 metadata):
the cells above `m` return to available (the top returns to the top of `m`), the blocks from that
top are forgotten, `m` and every later mark are removed. -/
def rewindMeta (st : Stack) (m : Mark) : Stack :=
  { st with
    top := m.top
    blocks := st.blocks.filter fun x => decide (x.base < m.top)
    marks := st.marks.takeWhile fun x => decide (x ≠ m) }

/-- `rewind(j, m)` (DS-v2, non-normative): `fail`, the state unchanged, on a missing stack (DS2-6)
and on a dead or foreign mark, a mark of a dead stack included (DS2-3), before the right; `reject`
without the administrative right of §36; then the derived `reset` of Part XIV on the cells above
`m` (DS2-4): `split` of `internal` on them (O2), which rejects when an active authority derived from
`internal` covers one of them (`rewind_rejects_live_above`), and `release` of the derived authority
(O3); `ok`: the cells return to available, `m` and the later marks are removed. -/
inductive RewindStep (k : K) (j : Nat) (m : Mark) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → RewindStep k j m D .fail
  | dead {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → ¬ LiveMark D.kern j st m →
      RewindStep k j m D .fail
  | static {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m →
      ¬ AdminRight D.kern st → RewindStep k j m D .reject
  | split {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m → AdminRight D.kern st →
      SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
  | release {st : Stack} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m →
      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → RewindStep k j m D .reject
  | ok {st : Stack} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → LiveMark D.kern j st m →
      AdminRight D.kern st → SplitStep k st.internal [above st m] D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep D.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      RewindStep k j m D (.ok ⟨s₂, D.stacks.set j (rewindMeta st m), D.fresh⟩)

/-- `rewind` has one outcome (§58: a guarded transition has one outcome; DS-v2, non-normative):
the cases of `RewindStep` exclude each other, the two `fail` cases (missing stack, DS2-6; dead or
foreign mark) give the same outcome, and `split` and `release` are deterministic (`Guarded.det`).
With `rewind_ok_iff`, an `ok` rewind is never also `reject` or `fail`. -/
theorem RewindStep.det {k : K} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} {D : DState} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 DState}
    (h₁ : RewindStep k j m D o₁) (h₂ : RewindStep k j m D o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ with
  | noStack h =>
    cases h₂ with
    | noStack _ => rfl
    | dead _ _ => rfl
    | static h' _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
    | split h' _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
    | release h' _ _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
    | ok h' _ _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
  | dead h hl =>
    cases h₂ with
    | noStack _ => rfl
    | dead _ _ => rfl
    | static h' hl' _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
    | split h' hl' _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
    | release h' hl' _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
    | ok h' hl' _ _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl' hl
  | static h hl ha =>
    cases h₂ with
    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
    | static _ _ _ => rfl
    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
    | ok h' _ ha' _ _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd ha' ha
  | split h hl _ hs =>
    cases h₂ with
    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
    | static _ _ _ => rfl
    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
    | ok h' _ _ hs' _ => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'
  | release h hl _ hs hr =>
    cases h₂ with
    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
    | static _ _ _ => rfl
    | split _ _ _ _ => rfl
    | release _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
    | ok h' _ _ hs' hr' =>
      rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'; cases Guarded.det hr hr'
  | ok h hl ha hs hr =>
    cases h₂ with
    | noStack h' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'
    | dead h' hl' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd hl hl'
    | static h' _ ha' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact absurd ha ha'
    | split h' _ _ hs' => rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'
    | release h' _ _ hs' hr' =>
      rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'; cases Guarded.det hr hr'
    | ok h' _ _ hs' hr' =>
      rw [h] at h'; cases h'; cases Guarded.det hs hs'; cases Guarded.det hr hr'; rfl

/-- `rewind_missing_fails` (DS-v2, non-normative, DS2-6: `rewind` on a stack index that does not
exist is `fail`, like an invalid mark, before the right of §36; §58 `fail`): on a missing stack,
`rewind m` fails, with no other outcome, for every mark `m`. -/
theorem rewind_missing_fails {k : K} {D : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark}
    (h : D.stacks[j]? = none) :
    RewindStep k j m D .fail ∧ ∀ o, RewindStep k j m D o → o = .fail :=
  ⟨.noStack h, fun _ ho => ho.det (.noStack h)⟩

/-! ## `grow` (DS-v2: in place, the derived `issue`) -/

/-- In-place extension (DS-v2, non-normative: "extension into the space directly after the
block"; the availability check of the derived `issue`, §77.4): `extra` is zero, the empty
extension, always available (§77.4: "The empty region is always available"; DS2-5: an in-place
reissue of the same region), or the block ends at the top and `extra` available cells follow it. -/
def InPlace (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Prop :=
  extra = 0 ∨ (x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ st.top + extra ≤ st.cells.length)

/-- Decidability of `InPlace` (§77.4; DS-v2). -/
instance (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra : Nat) : Decidable (InPlace st x extra) := by
  unfold InPlace; infer_instance

/-- The grown block (DS-v2, non-normative: same base, `extra` more cells, new authority `a`,
destination `d`, the place that held the authority of the block, DS2-2; an issuance of §46). -/
def growBlk (x : Blk) (extra a d : Nat) : Blk := ⟨x.base, x.size + extra, a, d⟩

/-- Metadata after `grow` (DS-v2, non-normative; as the `ok` effect of §77 on §46 metadata): the
top rises by `extra`; the block is replaced by the grown block. -/
def growMeta (st : Stack) (x : Blk) (extra a d : Nat) : Stack :=
  { st with
    top := st.top + extra
    blocks := st.blocks.map fun y => if y.auth = x.auth then growBlk x extra a d else y }

/-- The place that holds authority `a`, if a place holds it (§42: holder; DS-v2, non-normative,
DS2-2: the destination of `grow` is the place that currently holds the block authority). -/
def holderPlace (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- `grow(j, b, extra)` (DS-v2, non-normative: in place only, using the derived `issue`): `reject`
when `b` is not a block of the stack; `extra` may be zero, an in-place reissue of the same region
(DS2-5); `release` of `b` (O3); then the derived
`issue` of Part XIV (`Arena.IssueD`) of the region of the same base and of size `size + extra` into
the place `d` that holds `b` when `grow` starts (DS2-2), on the released state: `reject` when no
place holds `b` (there is no destination, §77.2; never on library-reachable states,
`DReach.grow_holder`), its static checks (`IssueStatic`, §77.1, §77.2), `fail`, the state
unchanged, unless the extension is in place (DS-v1 "fail otherwise", availability §77.4), `split`
of `internal` (O2) and `store` of the new block into `d` (O8). -/
inductive GrowStep (k : K) (j b extra : Nat) (D : DState) : Outcome3 DState → Prop where
  | noStack : D.stacks[j]? = none → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | noBlock {st : Stack} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = none →
      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | release {st : Stack} {x : Blk} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
      ReleaseStep b D.kern .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | noHolder {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} : D.stacks[j]? = some st → st.block b = some x →
      ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) → holderPlace D.kern b = none →
      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | static {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
      ¬ IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d →
      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | fail {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d →
      ¬ InPlace st x extra → GrowStep k j b extra D .fail
  | split {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d → InPlace st x extra →
      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ .reject →
      GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | store {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d → InPlace st x extra →
      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      StoreStep s₁.A.length d s₂ .reject → GrowStep k j b extra D .reject
  | ok {st : Stack} {x : Blk} {s₁ s₂ s₃ : S3} {d : Nat} : D.stacks[j]? = some st →
      st.block b = some x → ReleaseStep b D.kern (.ok s₁) →
      holderPlace D.kern b = some d →
      IssueStatic s₁ st.entry (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) d → InPlace st x extra →
      SplitStep k st.internal [cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)] s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      StoreStep s₁.A.length d s₂ (.ok s₃) →
      GrowStep k j b extra D
        (.ok ⟨s₃, D.stacks.set j (growMeta st x extra s₁.A.length d), D.fresh⟩)

/-! ## Library runs (DS-v2; §36, §56, §57) -/

/-- One `ok` step of the stack library (DS-v2, non-normative): a kernel step O1–O16 of
non-administrative code, the registry unchanged; `newStack` with the guard of §56 against the other
registries `others`; `push`, `mark`, `rewind`, `grow`. -/
inductive DStep (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
  | kernel {D : DState} {s' : S3} : KStep k D.kern s' → DStep k D ⟨s', D.stacks, D.fresh⟩
  | newStack {D D' : DState} {others : List (List Nat)} {storage i : Nat} :
      NewStackStep others storage i D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
  | push {D D' : DState} {j size dst : Nat} : PushStep k j size dst D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
  | mark {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} : MarkStep j D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
  | rewind {D D' : DState} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} : RewindStep k j m D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'
  | grow {D D' : DState} {j b extra : Nat} : GrowStep k j b extra D (.ok D') → DStep k D D'

/-- States reachable from the initial state by library steps (DS-v2, non-normative; §47). -/
inductive DReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : DState → Prop where
  | init : DReach k statics (DState.init statics)
  | step {D D' : DState} : DReach k statics D → DStep k D D' → DReach k statics D'

/-- Finite sequences of library steps (DS-v2, non-normative; §58 `ok` transitions). -/
inductive DRun (k : K) : DState → DState → Prop where
  | refl (D : DState) : DRun k D D
  | tail {D D' D'' : DState} : DRun k D D' → DStep k D' D'' → DRun k D D''

/-- The kernel part of a library step is reached by kernel steps (§36: the abstraction adds no
rights to the kernel; Part XIV: `issue` is `split` then `store`, the reset part of `rewind` is
`split` then `release`; DS-v2). -/
theorem DStep.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {D D' : DState}
    (hr : Reachable k statics D.kern) (h : DStep k D D') : Reachable k statics D'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact .step hr hk
  | newStack hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact hr

26:library-reachable and that its kernel state is reached by kernel steps and ends of slot contents.
import Ern.Corpus.LibRunner

/-!
# Corpus: library cases (test module)

Library cases of the Jalon 3 material (`ERN_Jalon3_materiel.md`; non-normative design material)
and of the corrected handle-pool contract, run on the reference kernel of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` (§60–§75), the arena of Part XIV (§76–§78), the
handle pool of `Ern.Lib.HandlePool` (contract "HandlePool v0.4 annex", non-normative, corrected by
§36 and §56: composite borrow, `resolveMany` in `Observe` without distinctness, `Modify` right on
the pool value, live pool, `newPool` on `Uninit` storage, `freeSlot` exempting `internal` and its
ancestors) and the stack of `Ern.Lib.DataStack` (contract "DS-v1", non-normative). This is a test
module: no model or library module imports it.

* Section G of corpus MM3-H (material §1 G, handles): H30–H34b, H44.
* Cases of the corrected handle-pool contract: stale, other pool, atomic and distinct batches,
  `resolveMany` in `Observe` with a repeated handle, `freeSlot` with a derived `internal`, under the
  `Modify` right only, on a dead pool, of a free slot; `newPool` on written storage; two pools on
  one storage (`pool_two_freeSlot_cross`).
* The guard of §56 across registries: a second administration (arena, pool, stack) on the
  `internal` of a live administration of another registry, or of the same registry for pools.
* The usage scenarios W1 and W2 of material §5b (W3 is in `Ern.Corpus.MM3H`).

Each case is a run from `CState.init statics` (§47) by the combined runner
(`Ern.Corpus.LibRunner`): `CRunsTo k statics os C` states that every step is `ok`, that `C` is
library-reachable and that its kernel state is reached by kernel steps and ends of slot contents.
The verdict of the step under test is stated with the relation of its operation on the projected
state (`ResolveStep`, `FreeSlotStep`, `NewPoolStep`, `NewArenaStep`, `NewStackStep`, `StoreStep`,
`TransferStep`, …) and decided by `decide`. Each docstring gives the expected verdict from the
case's source, the obtained verdict, the class (material §0, rule 5: `Lib` library instance) and
the positive twin of each rejection or `fail` (rule 2: the same sequence without the faulty
element, accepted). A case whose obtained verdict differs from the expected one keeps its expected
verdict and is marked **MISMATCH** with its cause.

Twins that are not literally the same sequence without one faulty step:
* another handle, entry, target, parameter or identity in place of the faulty one: H30 (the handle
  of generation 1), H31b (two distinct entries), H33 (the local 4), H34b (pool 0),
  `resolveMany_atomic` (the valid handle `⟨0, 1, 0⟩`), `pool_shared_right` (a `Modify` parameter),
  `pool_two_freeSlot_cross` at `newPool` (`internal` 6), `pool_two_on_one_internal`,
  `arena_on_pool_internal`, `pool_on_arena_internal`, `stack_on_arena_internal`,
  `arena_on_stack_internal`, `stack_on_pool_internal`, `pool_on_stack_internal` (`internal` 5), W1
  `fail` (the handle of the live first node);
* further steps that lift the blocking before the step under test: H31a (`unresolve 5`, for the
  other entry and for the `Observe` resolution) and H32 (`unresolve`), `pool_free_entry_handle`
  (`allocSlot` first), W1 `reject` (`unresolve`), W2 (`release` of 12 and 11, and the transfer
  9 → 16);
* a faulty element of several steps, removed: `pool_two_freeSlot_cross` at `resolve` (the
  authority 6 and the steps that use it; removing pool 1 alone leaves the `reject`);
* no positive twin: the `reject` of H31a for the stale handle `⟨0, 1, 7⟩`: after `unresolve 5`
  its resolution is `fail`, the defined failure of a stale generation (§89), stated in H31a; the
  twin is a defined failure, not an accepted run. The step has two faults (the companion and the
  stale generation), so no accepted twin exists and rule 2's first sentence is unmet; rule 2 does
  not say how to class such a step: open for arbitration.

Local shapes are lists of (parent, kind) (§71.1, §72); `lf` is a root leaf, `pt p` a part of
place `p`. Places and authorities are list indices (§38): `enterFrame` appends the locals and one
root authority per local; `alloc` appends the shape and one root authority; `derive` and `split`
append the derived authorities; `issue` appends one block authority; `reset` appends one released
authority; `resolve` appends a companion and an entry authority; `resolveMany` a companion and one
entry authority per handle. Pools and stacks are named by their registry index; a handle is
`⟨pool identity, slot index, generation⟩`.
-/

namespace Ern.Corpus.Lib

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena Ern.Corpus Ern.Corpus.LibRunner

911:    (h : CRunsTo k statics os C) (ho : os.all COp.kernelOnly = true) :
/-- Combined library states reachable from `CState.init statics` (§47) by `ok` steps of the kernel
and of the three libraries (Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2). -/
inductive CReach (k : K) (statics : Statics) : CState → Prop where
  | init : CReach k statics (CState.init statics)
  | step {C C' : CState} {o : COp} : CReach k statics C → CRel k C o (.ok C') →
      CReach k statics C'

section Runs
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A run of `os` from `CState.init statics` (§47) has only `ok` steps and reaches `C`; `C` is
library-reachable, and its kernel state is reached by kernel steps O1–O16 and ends of slot contents
(§57; HandlePool v0.5, D.3). -/
structure CRunsTo (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) (C : CState) : Prop where
  /-- Every step is `ok` and the run ends in `C`. -/
  run : crun k (CState.init statics) os = some C
  /-- `C` is library-reachable. -/
  creach : CReach k statics C
  /-- The kernel state of `C` is reached by kernel steps and ends of slot contents. -/
  xreach : HandlePool.XReach k statics C.kern

/-- The run of `os` from `CState.init statics` has only `ok` steps (§47, §57). -/
abbrev CRuns (statics : Statics) (os : List COp) : Prop :=
  CRunsTo k statics os (cfinal k statics os)
  | ok => intro _ hs; exact hs
  | reject => intro h; cases h
  | fail => intro h; cases h

end Sound

/-! ## Kernel side of library steps (§57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5, D.3; DS-v2) -/

/-- A sequence of kernel steps from a reachable state ends in a reachable state (§57). -/
theorem reachable_kseq {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s)
    (h : HandlePool.KSeq k s s') : Reachable k statics s' := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hr
  | tail _ hs ih => exact .step ih hs

/-- The kernel part of an arena library step is a sequence of kernel steps (Part XIV, §57:
`newArena` changes no kernel component, `issue` is `split` then `store`, `reset` is `derive` then
`release`). -/
theorem LStep.kseq {k : K} {L L' : LState} (h : LStep k L L') :
    HandlePool.KSeq k L.kern L'.kern := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact .single hk
  | newArena hs => rw [newArena_kernel hs]; exact .refl _
  | issue hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact (HandlePool.KSeq.single (.split hsp)).tail (.store hst)
  | reset hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hd hrl _ => exact (HandlePool.KSeq.single (.derive hd)).tail (.release hrl)

theorem crel_kside {k : K} {C C' : CState} {o : COp} (h : CRel k C o (.ok C'))
    (hw : o.kok C = true) : HandlePool.KSeq k C.kern C'.kern := by
  cases o with
  | newPool st i =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hx
    exact (.refl _)
  | allocSlot j d =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok =>
      simp only [COp.kok, Option.isSome_iff_exists] at hw
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hw
      exact (.single (.write (a := a) (Guarded.ok (writer_sound ha))))
  | resolve j h m =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ hR _ hE =>
      exact ((HandlePool.KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).tail (.derive (Guarded.ok hE)))
  | resolveMany j hs m =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ hR hE =>
      exact ((HandlePool.KSeq.single (.derive (Guarded.ok hR))).trans
        (HandlePool.entries_kseq hE))
  | unresolve c =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ hr => exact (HandlePool.releaseAll_kseq hr)
  | freeSlot j h =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok => exact .refl _
  | newStack st i =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hx
    exact (.refl _)
  | push j n d =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hst => exact ((HandlePool.KSeq.single (.split hsp)).tail (.store hst))
  | mark j =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ => exact (.refl _)
  | rewind j m =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ _ hsp hrl => exact ((HandlePool.KSeq.single (.split hsp)).tail (.release hrl))
  | grow j b e =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    cases hx with
    | ok _ _ hrl _ _ _ hsp hst =>
      exact (((HandlePool.KSeq.single (.release hrl)).tail (.split hsp)).tail (.store hst))
  | newArena st i =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    exact (LStep.kseq (.newArena hx))
  | _ =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    exact (LStep.kseq (opRel_ok hx))

section RunSound
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A completed run from a library-reachable state whose kernel state is reached by kernel steps
and ends of slot contents ends in such a state (§57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2). -/
theorem crun_reach {statics : Statics} :
    ∀ {C C' : CState} {os : List COp}, CReach k statics C →
      HandlePool.XReach k statics C.kern → crun k C os = some C' →
      CReach k statics C' ∧ HandlePool.XReach k statics C'.kern
  | _, _, [], hC, hX, h => by cases h; exact ⟨hC, hX⟩
  | C, _, o :: os, hC, hX, h => by
    unfold crun at h
    have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
    cases e : cstep k C o with
    | ok C₁ =>
      rw [e] at h hs
      dsimp only at h
      split at h
      · next hw =>
        refine crun_reach (.step hC hs) ?_ h
        rcases crel_kside hs hw with hk | ⟨-, q, i, hpre, he⟩
        · exact hX.kseq hk
        · rw [he]; exact .step hX (.contentEnd hpre)
      · cases h
    | reject => rw [e] at h; cases h
    | fail => rw [e] at h; cases h

/-- A completed run without `freeSlot` from a kernel-reachable state ends in a kernel-reachable
state (§57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2). -/
theorem crun_reachable {statics : Statics} :
    ∀ {C C' : CState} {os : List COp}, Reachable k statics C.kern →
      os.all COp.kernelOnly = true → crun k C os = some C' → Reachable k statics C'.kern
  | _, _, [], hr, _, h => by cases h; exact hr
  | C, _, o :: os, hr, ho, h => by
    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at ho
    unfold crun at h
    have hs := cstep_sound (k := k) C o
    cases e : cstep k C o with
    | ok C₁ =>
      rw [e] at h hs
      dsimp only at h
      split at h
      · next hw =>
        refine crun_reachable ?_ ho.2 h
        rcases crel_kside hs hw with hk | ⟨hf, -⟩
        · exact reachable_kseq hr hk
        · rw [ho.1] at hf; cases hf
      · cases h
    | reject => rw [e] at h; cases h
    | fail => rw [e] at h; cases h

/-- **Run soundness** (§47, §57; Part XIV; HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2): when the run of `os` from
`CState.init statics` completes, it reaches `cfinal k statics os`, which is library-reachable and
whose kernel state is reached by kernel steps O1–O16 and ends of slot contents. -/
theorem crunsTo {statics : Statics} {os : List COp}
    (h : (crun k (CState.init statics) os).isSome = true) : CRuns k statics os := by
  have hr : crun k (CState.init statics) os = some (cfinal k statics os) := by
    unfold cfinal
    cases e : crun k (CState.init statics) os with
    | none => rw [e] at h; cases h
    | some C => rfl
  obtain ⟨hc, hx⟩ := crun_reach .init .init hr
  exact ⟨hr, hc, hx⟩

/-- A completed run without `freeSlot` reaches a kernel-reachable state (§57; Part XIV;
HandlePool v0.5; DS-v2). -/
theorem CRunsTo.reachable {statics : Statics} {os : List COp} {C : CState}
    (h : CRunsTo k statics os C) (ho : os.all COp.kernelOnly = true) :
    Reachable k statics C.kern :=
  crun_reachable .init ho h.run

end RunSound

end Ern.Corpus.LibRunner

#!/bin/bash
# usage: axcheck.sh Module.Name [Module.Name ...]   (run after lake build of those modules)
SP=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/ref
F=$SP/axcheck_$$.lean
{
  echo "import Lean"
  for m in "$@"; do echo "import $m"; done
  echo 'open Lean Elab Command in'
  echo '#eval show Lean.Core.CoreM Unit from do'
  echo '  let env ← getEnv'
  printf '  for modName in [%s] do\n' "$(printf '`%s, ' "$@" | sed 's/, $//')"
  cat <<'L'
    let some mod := env.getModuleIdx? modName | throwError "no module"
    let mut all := 0
    let mut thms := 0
    let mut bad : Array (Name × Array Name) := #[]
    for (n, ci) in env.constants.map₁.toList do
      if env.getModuleIdxFor? n == some mod then
        all := all + 1
        if let .thmInfo _ := ci then thms := thms + 1
        let axs ← collectAxioms n
        let extra := axs.filter fun a => a != ``propext && a != ``Quot.sound
        if !extra.isEmpty then bad := bad.push (n, extra)
    IO.println s!"{modName}: constants {all}, theorems {thms}"
    IO.println s!"outside propext, Quot.sound: {bad}"
L
} > $F
cd /Users/guygouri/Devlab/ernlang/ern/formal && ~/.elan/bin/lake env lean $F

open Ern.MemoryModel Ern.MemoryModel.Access Ern.MemoryModel.Arena Ern.Corpus Ern.Corpus.LibRunner
  Ern.Lib

/-! ## Test contracts and shapes (§48, §72) -/

/-- The empty test contract (§48): nothing shared, pinned, externally done or deallocable. -/
abbrev K0 : K := KD.toK {}

/-- A root leaf of a local shape (§72, §71.1). -/
abbrev lf : Option Nat × Nat := (none, 0)

/-- A leaf part of place `p` (§72, §71.1). -/
abbrev pt (p : Nat) : Option Nat × Nat := (some p, 0)

/-! ## G. Handles (material §1 G; HandlePool v0.4 annex) -/

/-- Pool base of section G (§72, §71, §67; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1): frame 1 with the allocator
0 and the pool value 1, written, and the handle leaves 2 and 3; storage 4 (entries 5 and 6)
allocated, owned by the pool value, its root authority 4 held by it; `newPool 4 4`: pool 0 of
identity 0, slots 5 and 6, free, generation 0. -/
def pb : List COp := [.enter [] [lf, lf, lf, lf], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
  .alloc 0 1 [lf, pt 4, pt 4], .newPool 4 4]

/-- Run of H30 (HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3): the slot 0 allocated (handle in 2), freed, then
allocated again (handle in 3, generation 1). -/
def h30o : List COp := pb ++ [.allocSlot 0 2, .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, .allocSlot 0 3]
/-- State reached by `h30o` (§57). -/
def h30 : CState := cfinal K0 [] h30o

/-- **H30** (material §1 G, class Lib). Resolution of a handle after the release and the reuse of
its entry. Expected (material, HandlePool contract, generation; §89): `fail`. Obtained: `fail`:
the slot is live at generation 1, the handle carries generation 0 (§89: "a stale identity or
generation leads to defined failure"). Twin, the handle of the reused entry: `resolve` is `ok`. -/
theorem H30 : CRunsTo K0 [] h30o h30 ∧
    h30.pools = [⟨0, 4, 4, [⟨5, 1, true⟩, ⟨6, 0, false⟩]⟩] ∧

/-- **H32** (material §1 G, class Lib). `freeSlot` while a resolved access on the entry is active.
Expected (material, end of a borrow; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.3: "aucune descendante active d'une
compagne ne doit subsister sur cette entrée"): `reject`. Obtained: `reject`: the entry authority 6,
a descendant of the companion 5, and the companion itself cover the slot 5 (`ContentEndPre`
fails). The `freeSlot` of the other slot 1 during the same resolution is `reject` as well, the
companion covering the whole storage (material §4: "pendant toute résolution du pool"). Twin, after
`unresolve` of the resolution: both `ok`. -/
theorem H32 : CRunsTo K0 [] h31o h31 ∧
    HandlePool.FreeSlotStep K0 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ h31.toP .reject ∧
    HandlePool.FreeSlotStep K0 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩ h31.toP .reject ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (h31o ++ [.unresolve 5, .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩]) ∧
    CRuns K0 [] (h31o ++ [.unresolve 5, .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩]) :=
  ⟨crunsTo (by decide), crejects (k := K0) (C := h31) (o := .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩) (by decide),
    crejects (k := K0) (C := h31) (o := .freeSlot 0 ⟨0, 1, 0⟩) (by decide), crunsTo (by decide),
    crunsTo (by decide)⟩

/-- Run of H33 (§72, §71; HandlePool v0.4 annex, D.1–D.3): frame 1 with the local 0 passes 1,
`Modify` on it, to frame 2, which has the allocator 1, the pool value 2, the handle leaf 3 and the
local 4; storage 5 (entries 6, 7) owned by the pool value, `internal` its root 6; pool 0; slot 0
allocated and resolved: companion 7, entry authority 8. -/
